verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no web-search endpoint that returns the full page content of search results in one call. The closest item is the Answers endpoint, which researches the live web and returns JSON with source URLs. That is an adjacent synthesized-answer feature, not full content for each result. Scrape, crawl and extract all start from a known URL, and the other search endpoints cover only news and brand autocomplete.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search the web and get full page content from results in a single call instead of just links and snippets
